1. (Currently amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within the timer period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor that is __perceptually distinct from the first alarm__.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer __and wherein the timer duration is configurable based on alarm priority level__.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm __and the second alarm comprises an audible alarm__.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm __with a frequency and volume greater than the first alarm__.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm __and has a different frequency pattern__.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously __and wherein the physiological monitor maintains a local record of the alarm condition independent of acknowledgement at the remote station__.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system __and wherein the central patient management system is capable of routing alarm notifications to multiple remote devices based on alarm priority and operator availability__.

16. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, __an escalation level, and an acknowledgement status__; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data __in a prioritized format based on alarm severity__.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system __and wherein the system is capable of operating independently or in communication with other monitoring systems__.

18. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm __and wherein the escalation level is automatically incremented based on time elapsed since alarm initiation without acknowledgement__.

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm __including the identity of the operator who acknowledged the alarm and the time of acknowledgement__.

20. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices __and wherein the wireless devices receive notifications only for alarms matching their configured priority thresholds__.
